context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — flight-stick tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — flight-stick tip body

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — lateral-thrust tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — lateral-thrust tip body
en: [The lower stick slides the ship sideways without turning — dodge incoming fire or drift across an enemy's aim.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — impulse-drive tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — impulse-drive tip body
en: [Impulse charges up and then hurls the ship forward in a burst. Press to start charging; press again to cancel.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — boost-ready contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — boost-ready contextual tip body
en: [Boost is charged. Hold the boost button for a burst of speed — the battery drains while it runs and recharges after.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert contextual tip body
en: [Hostile weapon arcs now paint onto your radar. Keep the ship out of the shaded wedges while Tactical returns fire.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit captain tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit captain tip body
en: [You command the destroyer. Read the sensor scope, point the viewscreen, keep the crew's objectives straight, and call Red Alert when it's time to fight.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — viewscreen-camera tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — viewscreen-camera tip body
en: [Switch the main viewscreen between camera angles so the crew sees what matters most right now.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — sensor-scan tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — sensor-scan tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the sensor scope to scan it — its class, heading and shield strength appear below.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — objectives tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — objectives tip body
en: [Boost an objective's priority to flag it for the crew as the current focus.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert-authority tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert-authority tip body
en: [Only you can call it. Red Alert arms the crew's weapons and puts hostile firing arcs on Helm's radar.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert-active contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert-active contextual tip body
en: [The ship is armed and hostile arcs are live on Helm's radar. Watch Sensors for threat details while the crew fights.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit tactical tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit tactical tip body
en: [You run the destroyer's guns. Lock a target on the radar, then work the omni phaser, forward blasters and torpedo tubes to bring it down — and keep an ear on Comms for orders.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — target-lock tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — target-lock tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the radar to lock it as your target. Blasters and torpedoes need a lock before they'll fire.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — omni-phaser tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — omni-phaser tip body
en: [The phaser fires in every direction and needs no lock. Toggle Auto/Manual, or press Fire yourself in Manual mode.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — forward-blasters tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — forward-blasters tip body
en: [Port and starboard blasters cover a narrow forward arc. Hold Fire to charge a volley, release to launch it.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — torpedo-tubes tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — torpedo-tubes tip body
en: [Fore and aft tubes load automatically. Use +/- to set how many rounds to hold loaded, then press Fire to launch them at your locked target.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — comms-overlay tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — comms-overlay tip body
en: [Open Comms to hail contacts and read incoming messages — the badge lights up when something new comes in.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit engineering tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit engineering tip body
en: [You keep the destroyer alive. Balance reactor power between Helm, Weapons and Sensors, focus shields toward incoming fire, and send repair teams to anything that's hurting.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — power-allocation tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — power-allocation tip body
en: [Use +/- to shift reactor power between groups. Pull power from what you don't need to push more into what you do.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — shield-focus tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — shield-focus tip body
en: [Focus an arc to boost its regen against the bearing you're taking fire from — every other arc regens slower while it's focused.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — repair-teams tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — repair-teams tip body
en: [Dispatch a team to a damaged system to start repairs. A team already on a job can be given priority over the others.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — hull-damage contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — hull-damage contextual tip body
en: [Something on the ship just took a hit. Check which system is hurting and get a repair team moving before it fails outright.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms] from
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms] message
en: [A.E.V. Ardent, this is Starcorp Command. You are ordered to proceed to the Axiom System immediately. Harrow vessels have been observed acting outside normal patrol parameters. Investigate and report. Do not engage unless fired upon. Command out.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms] message
en: [This is Axiom Station to any Alliance vessel — we have a situation. Our lead negotiator, Dr. Sol Varen, has gone missing. Their last confirmed position puts them near the Harrow patrol operating area. The peace talks cannot continue without them. Please respond.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.response] text
en: [Understood, Axiom Station. We are proceeding to your location.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.response.follow_up] message
en: [Ardent, we have you on the dock approach. Welcome to Axiom. Administrator Chen is preparing the full briefing now — stand by.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.response] text
en: [Axiom Station, do you know where the Harrow patrol is operating?]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.response.follow_up] message
en: [The Harrow patrol — I.V. Ironveil — was last observed near the inner asteroid belt, between our position and the outer system. They have not responded to our hails. I don't know what they're waiting for, but Dr. Varen is somewhere near their patrol route.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms] message
en: [A.E.V. Ardent, this is the Research Outpost. We read you. Stand by — patching you through to Dr. Myst now.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up] speaker
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up] message
en: [Ardent, this is Dr. Myst at the Research Outpost. I've been trying to reach someone for hours. I'm detecting an intermittent stellar resonance signature from the deep outer system — beyond the Kaleth Nebula. The frequency profile matches a theoretical class of weapon I've encountered in Imperium research archives. Whatever is out there is charging.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response] text
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up] speaker
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up] message
en: [If it fires at full charge it will create a persistent quantum interference zone across this system. It's not a targeted weapon — it's a geography weapon. Navigation through this system will be effectively impossible for decades. The charge cycle is approximately twenty minutes. I don't know how far along they are. The signature is already strong.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up.response] text
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up.response.action] text
en: [Locate the weapon source beyond the Kaleth Nebula.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response] text
en: [Is there anything unusual about the signal?]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up] speaker
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up] message
en: [Yes — there's a sub-harmonic embedded in the resonance signature I cannot explain. It doesn't match any known Harrow or Imperium technology. It may be nothing. Or it may be something this system has been doing for longer than the Harrow have been pointing weapons at it. I've flagged it in my logs.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms.follow_up.response.follow_up.response] text
assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [comms] message
en: [This channel is not secure. We know what Ashrender carries. When the time comes, there may be an alternative. Stand by.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [trigger.action] text
en: [I.V. Ironveil destroyed. Ashrender executing contingency — Aphelion Protocol armed.]

context: assets/worlds/before_the_fire.toml → [trigger.action] text
en: [Aphelion Protocol armed on schedule — Ashrender is charging the weapon.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [entity] name (entity display name; also the cross-reference key)
assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [trigger.action] text
en: [Aphelion Protocol armed. Choose your response: Fight, Evacuate, Contain, or Override.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [trigger.action] message
en:
[PARTIAL DETONATION — The Aphelion weapon discharged on Ashrender's destruction, triggering a partial resonance cascade. Axiom Station sustained heavy structural damage. The quantum interference zone has formed — smaller than planned, but permanent. It will grow over decades. In 35 years it will be called the Neutral Zone.

Harrow High Command issued a communiqué within hours: an Alliance warship destroyed an Imperium vessel in the Axiom System during peace negotiations. The A.E.V. Ardent is named. The war begins not with a declaration but with a press release.

The Neutral Zone exists because you fought.

END: FIGHT]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [trigger.action] text
en: [Containment position held. Survive 30 seconds in the radiation discharge zone.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [trigger.action] message
en:
[CONTAINMENT HELD — Ardent absorbed the weapon's discharge. Hull integrity critical; multiple console failures. The quantum resonance was partially contained — the interference zone formed but smaller than projected.

Axiom Station survived. Kaleth Prime sustained atmospheric disturbance but no population loss. The A.E.V. Ardent limped to Axiom Station under emergency power. Three crew were lost to hull breach. The rest received commendations they never spoke about.

The Neutral Zone exists because you stood in the way.

END: CONTAINMENT]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [trigger.action] message
en:
[EVACUATION COMPLETE — The weapon fired. Axiom Station and the Kaleth Prime orbital platforms were destroyed. But 70% of the civilian population reached safety. The quantum interference zone formed as predicted.

Starcorp Command's official account credits the A.E.V. Ardent with saving an estimated 28 million lives. Your name appears in the historical record not as the crew that stopped the war, but as the crew that made it survivable.

The Neutral Zone exists because you chose people over victory.

END: EVACUATE]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [trigger.action] message
en:
[PARTIAL EVACUATION — The weapon fired. Casualties were reduced but not minimised. The quantum interference zone formed.

You saved some of them. The records note the partial evacuation effort.

The Neutral Zone exists.

END: EVACUATE (PARTIAL)]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms] message
en: [This is I.V. Ashrender to A.E.V. Ardent. The Aphelion Protocol is armed and charging. You cannot stop this. What you choose to do in the next ten minutes will determine which side history blames. Stand clear.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms] from
assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms] message
en: [Ardent, this is Starcorp Command — FLASH priority. Aphelion Protocol confirmed active. You are hereby ordered to stand down and withdraw immediately. Do NOT engage Harrow forces. We cannot afford an incident. Command out.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms] message
en: [This is the channel you were told to stand by for. We have the weapon's abort code. One accepted exchange and Ashrender cannot fire. There will be consequences for us — but the weapon will not fire. Your move, Ardent.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms] message
en: [Ardent, we've received the evacuation order. We're beginning to load the shuttles but we need navigation vectors — Helm, plot us an escape route away from the weapon's axis of fire. Science, we need atmospheric dispersal models for Kaleth Prime's eastern continent evacuation. Acknowledge.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response] text
en: [Vectors confirmed. Initiating evacuation coordination — round one.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.action] text
en: [Evacuation round 1 complete. Hail Axiom Station for the next vector.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.follow_up] message
en: [First vector confirmed. We have 40% of the civilian population moving. We need two more vectors before the weapon fires. Round two — deep colony vectors and sub-orbital trajectories for the northern settlements. Helm, compensate for the interference zone forming on the starboard approach.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.follow_up.response] text
assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.follow_up.response.action] text
en: [Evacuation round 2 complete. One more vector needed.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.follow_up.response.follow_up] message
en: [Second vector confirmed. We're at 70% evacuation capacity. Final vector — the weapon is nearly charged. Whatever happens in the next few minutes, Ardent, you've saved most of them. Transmit the final trajectory and we'll execute.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.follow_up.response.follow_up.response] text
assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.follow_up.response.follow_up.response.action] text
assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms] message
en: [Confirm: you are accepting the override channel. Once you acknowledge, we transmit the abort code and Ashrender cannot fire. But Harrow will know we helped you. They will come for us. This is the price of doing the right thing at the wrong time. Confirm acceptance.]

context: assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response] text
assets/worlds/btf_aphelion_protocol.toml → [comms.response.action] message
en:
[REQUIEM OVERRIDE — The abort code was transmitted. Ashrender's weapon discharge sequence terminated. I.V. Ashrender stands down.

Within minutes, Harrow warships arrived in the Axiom System. The Requiem courier was destroyed. House Requiem was denounced as traitors to the Imperium. High Executor Veth Harrow had the casus belli he needed — not a weapon discharge, but an act of treachery.

The war began differently. It began the same.

The quantum resonance from Ashrender's aborted charge left a sub-harmonic scar in the system's spatial fabric. Smaller than the full discharge would have created. But permanent. In 35 years, navigators will notice something strange about this region of space.

The Neutral Zone exists because a deal was made.

END: REQUIEM OVERRIDE]

context: Help modal — captain station, section 3 heading

en: [Keep the main screen camera updated so the whole bridge sees what matters right now.]

en: [Keep the ship moving and the target in arc for Tactical. You control where the fight happens.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 2 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 2 body text
en: [Drag to accelerate, reverse, or steer. WASD or the arrow keys steer too, as does a gamepad stick.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 3 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 3 body text
en: [10× speed burst for rapid travel. Damage cancels it, so it's best for non-combat travel. Press Ctrl or gamepad B to charge, again to cancel.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 4 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 4 body text
en: [Hold Shift or gamepad A for 3× speed while the battery lasts. It drains in a few seconds and takes far longer to refill, so save it for closing a gap.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 5 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 5 body text

Help modal — tactical station, section 1 body text
Help modal — tactical station, section 2 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 2 body text
en: [Lock first — phasers and torpedoes both require an active lock by clicking on the target.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 3 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 3 body text
en: [Fast and continuous but arc-limited. Enable Auto so they fire the instant the target crosses your fire arc.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 4 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 4 body text
en: [Use them when on priority target. They do less damage to shields than hull, sensors can monitor target shields.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 1 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 1 body text
en: [Keep the ship in the fight. Damaged systems degrade everyone's performance — act early.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 2 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 2 body text
en: [Your ship health gauge, it doesn't show where the damage is, the other bridge officers should ask for repairs.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 3 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 3 body text
en: [Dispatch teams to damaged consoles, sooner rather than later.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 1 heading
Help modal — power station, section 1 body text
en: [You decide how much performance each system gets. Shift allocations as the battle changes.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 2 heading
Help modal — power station, section 2 body text
en: [Distribute 6 base points across systems. Higher level means better performance from that station.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 3 heading
Help modal — power station, section 3 body text
en: [Holds up to 2 emergency power points. Let it drain completely and everyone gets locked out for a time.]

context: Help modal — shields station, section 1 heading
Help modal — shields station, section 1 body text
en: [Absorb incoming fire and keep the ship alive.]

context: Help modal — shields station, section 2 heading
Help modal — shields station, section 2 body text
Help modal — shields station, section 3 heading
Help modal — shields station, section 3 body text
en: [Concentrate capacity on one facing to tank heavy fire by tapping it. Tap again to rebalance shields]

context: Help modal — sensors station, section 1 heading
Help modal — sensors station, section 1 body text
en: [Extend the crew's awareness beyond visual range.]

context: Help modal — sensors station, section 2 heading
Help modal — sensors station, section 2 body text
en: [Detect contacts before they enter combat range and provides some extra information on their status]

context: Help modal — navigation station, section 1 heading

context: Help modal — navigation station, section 2 heading
Help modal — navigation station, section 2 body text
en: [Overlay the nav chart on the main screen so the Captain and Helm see the strategic picture.]

context: Help modal — navigation station, section 3 heading

context: Help modal — comms station, section 1 heading
Help modal — comms station, section 1 body text

Help modal — comms station, section 3 body text

en: [Mission goals update as the situation changes. Alert the Captain when new orders arrive.]

context: Help modal — engineering station, section 4 heading

en: [Dispatch teams to damaged systems. Damaged systems degrade everyone's performance — act early.]
